evaṃ kartṛkarmamanaḥsvarūpaṃ tannāmabhedaṃ ca bahubhiḥ prakāraiḥ
pratibodhito rāmaḥ svabuddhaṃ tadgurubuddhisaṃvādāyābhilapya darśayati -
brahmanniti

he brahman prāgdarśitatvadvākyārthādidamāḍambaraṃ
brahmāṇḍapaṭahaṃ manasa eva sakāśātsṛtamāvirbhūtaṃ yato'tastajjagadeva
manasaḥ karmeti tātparyamupalabhyate budhyate mayetyarthaḥ

yathā pṛthivyādibhūtatattvajijñāsūnāṃ tṛṇakāṣṭhādikaṃ pratyekaṃ na
vicāraṇārhaṃ tadvadityarthaḥ

evaṃ kartṛkarmasvarūpe buddhe tadviśodhena tadadhiṣṭhānātmānaṃ
darśayitumāha - manye iti
mana ādispandāstadbalenaiva na svata ityāha - tatprasādeneti

astvevaṃ manasaḥ sakāśājjagadutpattiḥ manastu
kūṭasthacinmātrasvabhāvādbrahmaṇo notpattumarhati

buddhipūrvikā hi
tatsṛṣṭiḥ śrūyate tanmano'kuruta ātmanvī syām iti

yadyapi dvādaśavidhā uktāstathāpi tāsāṃ
sāttvikarājasatāmasalakṣaṇatraividhyentarbhāvamabhipretya trividhā ityuktiḥ

imāmapyāśaṅkāṃ vakṣyamāṇadṛṣṭibhedābhiprāyeṇa
satkāryavādamāśritya samādhitsurvasiṣṭhastadupayuktāmākāśatrayakalpanāṃ
darśayati - ākāśā hīti

trayāṇāmekasattākatve cidākāśe ko'tiśaya ityāśaṅkya taṃ
darśayaṃścidākāśaṃ māyāśabalaṃ lakṣayati - sabāhyeti

tatra cidākāśe cidaṃśasya saṃnidhimātreṇa nimittateti pradarśayati - dinaṃ
yatheti

jaḍāṃśasya tu mana ādyākārapariṇāmitvānmanaḥ prati mukhyopādānatve'pi
manasi cijjāḍyobhayānubhavātsaṃvalitasyaiva manobhāvāpattirityāha -
jaḍo'smīti

iyaṃ ca manaḥsṛṣṭyādikalpanā ajñabodhanārthā na vāstavīti
paramārthadṛśā na śuddhacitaḥ kiṃcidutpannaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ veti na
kaścidākṣepāvakāśa ityāśayenāha - aprabuddhetyādinā

kāryeṣu mālinyadarśanādapi cittasya na śuddhacitkāryatetyāśayenāha -
cinotīti

ajñaikadṛśyatvādapi cittasyājñānakāryatvaṃ ata evātattvajñadṛśaiva
bandhastattvajñadṛśā tvātmano nityamuktataivetyāha - cittatvamiti
